Asa Newell.name: Asa Newell
Asa Newell.comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

Keshon Gilbert.name: Keshon Gilbert
Keshon Gilbert.comment: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

Mouhamed Gueye.name: Mouhamed Gueye
Mouhamed Gueye.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Henri Veesaar.name: Henri Veesaar
Henri Veesaar.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Paul George.name: Paul George
Paul George.comment: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

Nolan Traore.name: Nolan Traore
Nolan Traore.comment: Traore (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

Mikel Brown Jr..name: Mikel Brown Jr.
Mikel Brown Jr..comment: Brown has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to an illness, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.

Grant Williams.name: Grant Williams
Grant Williams.comment: Williams (hamstring) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against the Suns.

Moussa Diabate.name: Moussa Diabate
Moussa Diabate.comment: Diabate (quadriceps) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against the Suns.

Brandon Miller.name: Brandon Miller
Brandon Miller.comment: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

Kon Knueppel.name: Kon Knueppel
Kon Knueppel.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Dennis Schroder.name: Dennis Schroder
Dennis Schroder.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Dailyn Swain.name: Dailyn Swain
Dailyn Swain.comment: Swain (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

Norman Powell.name: Norman Powell
Norman Powell.comment: Powell (shoulder) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Spurs,Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

Tobe Awaka.name: Tobe Awaka
Tobe Awaka.comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

Caleb Wilson.name: Caleb Wilson
Caleb Wilson.comment: Wilson won't return to Wednesday's game against the Spurs due to a right hand injury. He'll finish with 15 points (5-7 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 3-3 FT), five rebounds and one steal in 15 minutes.

Sam Merrill.name: Sam Merrill
Sam Merrill.comment: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

Dereck Lively II.name: Dereck Lively II
Dereck Lively II.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

Tarik Biberovic.name: Tarik Biberovic
Tarik Biberovic.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

Sergio de Larrea.name: Sergio de Larrea
Sergio de Larrea.comment: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

Morez Johnson Jr..name: Morez Johnson Jr.
Morez Johnson Jr..comment: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

Julian Strawther.name: Julian Strawther
Julian Strawther.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Ugonna Onyenso.name: Ugonna Onyenso
Ugonna Onyenso.comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

Isaiah Joe.name: Isaiah Joe
Isaiah Joe.comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

Jalen Duren.name: Jalen Duren
Jalen Duren.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

Stephen Curry.name: Stephen Curry
Stephen Curry.comment: Steve Kerr told reporters Wednesday that Curry said he tweaked something in his abdominal area and "had never done it before." Kerr added that the concern level is high, but they will await the MRI results, Kelly Iko of Yahoo Sports reports.

Gary Payton II.name: Gary Payton II
Gary Payton II.comment: Payton (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

Brandon Williams.name: Brandon Williams
Brandon Williams.comment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

Kristaps Porzingis.name: Kristaps Porzingis
Kristaps Porzingis.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Moses Moody.name: Moses Moody
Moses Moody.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Jimmy Butler III.name: Jimmy Butler III
Jimmy Butler III.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Clint Capela.name: Clint Capela
Clint Capela.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

Steven Adams.name: Steven Adams
Steven Adams.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

Aaron Nesmith.name: Aaron Nesmith
Aaron Nesmith.comment: Nesmith will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to right knee soreness. He'll finish with two points (1-6 FG, 0-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist across 22 minutes.

Tyrese Haliburton.name: Tyrese Haliburton
Tyrese Haliburton.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

Johnny Furphy.name: Johnny Furphy
Johnny Furphy.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

Ben Sheppard.name: Ben Sheppard
Ben Sheppard.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Cam Christie.name: Cam Christie
Cam Christie.comment: Christie (ankle) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix.

Yanic Konan Niederhauser.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
Yanic Konan Niederhauser.comment: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

Brandon Ingram.name: Brandon Ingram
Brandon Ingram.comment: Ingram (Achilles) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

Bradley Beal.name: Bradley Beal
Bradley Beal.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

Jordan Miller.name: Jordan Miller
Jordan Miller.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Quentin Grimes.name: Quentin Grimes
Quentin Grimes.comment: Grimes (finger) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

Collin Sexton.name: Collin Sexton
Collin Sexton.comment: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

Austin Reaves.name: Austin Reaves
Austin Reaves.comment: Head coach JJ Redick said that X-rays on Reaves' left heel came back negative, but they won't have another update until he undergoes further imaging back in Los Angeles on Thursday, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

Luka Doncic.name: Luka Doncic
Luka Doncic.comment: Doncic finished Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks with 32 points (10-25 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 7-10 FT), five rebounds, five assists and three steals across 32 minutes. He exited to the locker room late in the fourth quarter due to an apparent right ankle injury and did not return, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

Quinten Post.name: Quinten Post
Quinten Post.comment: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets.

Scotty Pippen Jr..name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
Scotty Pippen Jr..comment: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

Richie Saunders.name: Richie Saunders
Richie Saunders.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Myles Turner.name: Myles Turner
Myles Turner.comment: Turner has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers due to rest.

Ryan Rollins.name: Ryan Rollins
Ryan Rollins.comment: Rollins (head) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 123-112 loss to the Lakers and did not return, finishing with eight points (3-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt), seven rebounds, four assists and one steal across 24 minutes.

Anthony Edwards.name: Anthony Edwards
Anthony Edwards.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Donte DiVincenzo.name: Donte DiVincenzo
Donte DiVincenzo.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

Bennedict Mathurin.name: Bennedict Mathurin
Bennedict Mathurin.comment: Mathurin has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets due to a right thumb sprain.

Trendon Watford.name: Trendon Watford
Trendon Watford.comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

Trey Murphy III.name: Trey Murphy III
Trey Murphy III.comment: Murphy (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

Yves Missi.name: Yves Missi
Yves Missi.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

Ajay Mitchell.name: Ajay Mitchell
Ajay Mitchell.comment: Mitchell has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a left ankle sprain.

Jaylin Williams.name: Jaylin Williams
Jaylin Williams.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

Thomas Sorber.name: Thomas Sorber
Thomas Sorber.comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

Cason Wallace.name: Cason Wallace
Cason Wallace.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Chet Holmgren.name: Chet Holmgren
Chet Holmgren.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Jalen Williams.name: Jalen Williams
Jalen Williams.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

Tristan da Silva.name: Tristan da Silva
Tristan da Silva.comment: Da Silva (calf) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Jazz.

Jamal Cain.name: Jamal Cain
Jamal Cain.comment: Cain (shoulder) is out for Wednesday's game in Utah.

Jalen Suggs.name: Jalen Suggs
Jalen Suggs.comment: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

Jonathan Isaac.name: Jonathan Isaac
Jonathan Isaac.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

Paolo Banchero.name: Paolo Banchero
Paolo Banchero.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Noah Penda.name: Noah Penda
Noah Penda.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson.name: Izaiyah Nelson
Izaiyah Nelson.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

Dominick Barlow.name: Dominick Barlow
Dominick Barlow.comment: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Adem Bona.name: Adem Bona
Adem Bona.comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Joel Embiid.name: Joel Embiid
Joel Embiid.comment: Embiid (foot) remains questionable for Thursday's game against the Raptors, but he participated in the team's morning shootaround, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

LeBron James.name: LeBron James
LeBron James.comment: James (back) remains questionable for Thursday's game against the Raptors, but he participated in the team's morning shootaround, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Ariel Hukporti.name: Ariel Hukporti
Ariel Hukporti.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Mark Williams.name: Mark Williams
Mark Williams.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Chris Youngblood.name: Chris Youngblood
Chris Youngblood.comment: Youngblood has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

Vit Krejci.name: Vit Krejci
Vit Krejci.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Ja Morant.name: Ja Morant
Ja Morant.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

Shaedon Sharpe.name: Shaedon Sharpe
Shaedon Sharpe.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Precious Achiuwa.name: Precious Achiuwa
Precious Achiuwa.comment: Achiuwa left Tuesday's 107-100 loss to the Magic with a left lower leg contusion and did not return, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

Maxime Raynaud.name: Maxime Raynaud
Maxime Raynaud.comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

Ben Simmons.name: Ben Simmons
Ben Simmons.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

Devin Vassell.name: Devin Vassell
Devin Vassell.comment: Vassell (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Bulls, Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio reports.

Tobias Harris.name: Tobias Harris
Tobias Harris.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

Jayden Quaintance.name: Jayden Quaintance
Jayden Quaintance.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Trayce Jackson-Davis.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
Trayce Jackson-Davis.comment: Jackson-Davis (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Celtics, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

Kawhi Leonard.name: Kawhi Leonard
Kawhi Leonard.comment: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

Scottie Barnes.name: Scottie Barnes
Scottie Barnes.comment: Barnes (groin) is out for Wednesday's game against Boston.

Nate Bittle.name: Nate Bittle
Nate Bittle.comment: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

Trey Alexander.name: Trey Alexander
Trey Alexander.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

Lauri Markkanen.name: Lauri Markkanen
Lauri Markkanen.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Jusuf Nurkic.name: Jusuf Nurkic
Jusuf Nurkic.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

Jaren Jackson Jr..name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
Jaren Jackson Jr..comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Tristan Vukcevic.name: Tristan Vukcevic
Tristan Vukcevic.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

Reece Beekman.name: Reece Beekman
Reece Beekman.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Justin Champagnie.name: Justin Champagnie
Justin Champagnie.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.name: Jamir Watkins
Jamir Watkins.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
